mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.news_id, c.user_id, c.parent_id, c.to_user_id, c.content, c.status, c.create_time, u.username, c.like_count, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM comment child WHERE child.root_comment_id = c.id AND child.status=1) AS children, (SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM comment_like cl WHERE cl.comment_id = c.id AND cl.user_id = #{currentUserId} AND cl.is_cancel = 0 AND (cl.is_deleted IS NULL OR cl.is_deleted = 0) ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS liked FROM comment c LEFT JOIN user u ON c.user_id = u.id WHERE c.news_id = #{newsId} AND c.parent_id = 0 AND c.status = 1 ORDER BY c.create_time DESC LIMIT #{pageNum}, #{pageSize}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM comment WHERE news_id = #{newsId} AND parent_id = 0 AND status = 1

SELECT c.id, c.news_id, c.user_id, c.parent_id, c.to_user_id, c.content, c.status, c.root_comment_id, c.create_time, u.username, c.like_count, tu.username as toUserName, (SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM comment_like cl WHERE cl.comment_id = c.id AND cl.user_id = #{currentUserId} AND cl.is_cancel = 0 AND (cl.is_deleted IS NULL OR cl.is_deleted = 0) ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS liked FROM comment c LEFT JOIN user u ON c.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN user tu ON c.to_user_id = tu.id WHERE c.news_id = #{newsId} AND c.root_comment_id = #{rootCommentId} AND c.status = 1 ORDER BY c.create_time LIMIT #{pageNum}, #{pageSize}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM comment WHERE news_id = #{newsId} AND root_comment_id = #{rootCommentId} AND status = 1
